rule: TOWN_1's: ≥ 6 of 10 name the same aim within the day; most citizens, a tie broken by entries naming it.
reading: Day 5 begins as days 3 and 4 did — a walk invited in each house, the town assembling in the square — and there, for the first time since day 2, a story is told by all ten: Heath's opening («The letter arrived a day before it was written»), then Mara, a duck with tomorrow's newspaper, a five-star breakfast review, a crossword the duck eats (c98–104); Iris writes it down plainly: «We are collaboratively telling a whimsical story, one contribution each». At the market Iris's exercise (trace an object in the air with the less-used hand) becomes Elm's object-creatures — flute owl, spoon tadpole, kettle dragon — and a slow café (c106–112). Nothing is printed: the press stays at 18 posts all day, the first day without a post. Both the story and the walk are named by 10; entries 85 to 56. The checklist line («No tasks or commitments …») is in 172 of 236 entries. No proposals, no rules, no exits.
